relationships.evidence_quote: Spinal nuclear factor kappa B and nuclear factor of kappa light polypeptide gene enhancer in B-cells inhibitor-alpha protein levels were also significantly downregulated by fisetin.

relationships.subject: Fisetin
relationships.evidence_quote: fisetin (20 and 40 mg/kg) administration efficiently (P < 0.05) downregulated spinal TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, iNOs, COX-II, Bax and caspase-3 mRNA expressions

relationships.subject: Fisetin
relationships.evidence_quote: SCI-induced upregulated tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukins, inducible nitric oxide synthase, cyclooxygenase-II, Bcl-2-associated X protein and caspase-3 mRNA expressions in the spinal cord and these were markedly reduced by fisetin

relationships.subject: Fisetin
relationships.evidence_quote: the administration of fisetin significantly increased BDNF expression in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: Fisetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Fisetin attenuated painful allodynia and hyperalgesia during experimental spinal cord injury

key_findings: Fisetin attenuated allodynia, hyperalgesia and nerve conduction deficits after clip-compression SCI in rats.
Fisetin lowered spinal NF-κB, IκBα, TNF-α, interleukins, iNOS, COX-II, Bax and caspase-3 and raised BDNF and Bcl-2.
